$Comment: Weakpoint node for the Roaming Temple. Renders the vanilla large blue crystal but is a real damageable entity, which the block cannot be. The model and texture are bundled copies under Items/ because ModelAsset only accepts Characters/, NPC/, Items/ and VFX/ as roots, and the crystal art lives under Resources/. HitBox is the mesh's own bounds measured by tools/measure_ore_model.py at the 32 units/block grid that block art uses, authored at unit scale; the variant's WeakpointScale grows it, and the spawner reads its centre back so a crystal sits on its socket instead of hovering off the leg. The bounds are lopsided because the crystal is a cluster leaning off its own origin rather than a symmetrical spike.
